open_risks.risk: Visible-local filtering may still admit cases whose decisive collision, drop, or contact is hidden from the initial RGB.
open_risks.mitigation: Instantiation must project sampled swept-footprint boundary/interior points and decisive hazard/contact points into the initial camera with depth and occlusion checks.

open_risks.risk: Body counterfactual cases can be solved by radius priors if no-flip controls are undersampled.
open_risks.mitigation: Require true small-only flips plus both-safe, neither-safe, large-shorter-same-bin, and radius-stable controls; report radius-only baseline performance.

open_risks.risk: Prompt metadata can become inconsistent if body-width horizons are fixed at category level despite varying radii and action horizons.
open_risks.mitigation: During instantiation, render meters and body-widths only from serialized per-case rollout metadata.

open_risks.risk: Local Hazard Explanation can drift into semantic scene recognition instead of rollout-grounded consequence QA.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep it diagnostic, derive labels from rollout fields first, and allow semantic context only for filtering/display.

open_risks.risk: Generator bugs could still render stale fixed horizon_m or horizon_body_widths instead of per-case values.
open_risks.mitigation: Serialize intended_distance_m, active_radius_m, body_width_m, horizon_body_widths, num_forward_steps, num_actions, and total_turn_deg for every candidate, and render prompts only from those fields.

open_risks.risk: Strict swept-envelope visibility checks may reduce accepted-case yield, especially for long horizons or side contacts.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan_id, episode_id, geometry_tag, action motif, horizon, body profile, and tentative label before validity filtering and downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Habitat body-profile configuration can silently violate radius monotonicity.
open_risks.mitigation: Reject and audit any counterfactual pair where the smaller radius has worse actual_distance_m or progress_ratio than the larger radius beyond tolerance.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk labels are invalid when support_loss or navmesh_support_violation fields are unavailable.
open_risks.mitigation: Render the three-way hazard variant without insufficient_support unless concrete support fields exist.

open_risks.risk: Answer balance can fail after visibility, stability, and monotonicity filters.
open_risks.mitigation: Continue stratified sampling or downsample majority labels until every category satisfies its single-answer-share cap before release.

open_risks.risk: Body-width horizon wording can become noisy if values are not rounded consistently.
open_risks.mitigation: Round meters and body-width counts from serialized metadata before prompt rendering, and audit rendered prompts before case release.

open_risks.risk: Body counterfactual questions still expose body size and can invite radius priors.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep true flip and no-flip quotas, enforce radius monotonicity, and report radius-only baseline performance.

open_risks.risk: Natural Chinese answers may vary despite constrained answer choices.
open_risks.mitigation: Use canonical labels plus explicit alias maps; mark unmatched, compound, or explanatory answers invalid for automatic scoring unless manually audited.

open_risks.risk: Prompts can be solved or misinterpreted as generic meter-distance questions rather than body-conditioned swept-volume questions if body-width horizon is omitted.
open_risks.mitigation: Render per-case body-width horizon in every template, computed from intended_distance_m and the active body width.

open_risks.risk: Static metric_parameters can leak inconsistent or wrong prompt values when num_forward_steps or radius changes.
open_risks.mitigation: Treat category metric_parameters as defaults only; serialize per-case action_sequence, intended_distance_m, active_radius_m, body_width_m, horizon_body_widths, and total_turn_deg.

open_risks.risk: Action-Horizon items may remain underspecified if the text gives only a natural action phrase without machine-checkable counts.
open_risks.mitigation: Require each item to store and render num_actions, num_forward_steps, total_turn_deg, intended_distance_m, and horizon_body_widths from serialized rollout metadata.

open_risks.risk: Future accepted cases may depend on hidden future geometry rather than visible single-RGB evidence.
open_risks.mitigation: In instantiation, require visible_gate_pass by projecting swept-footprint boundary/interior samples plus decisive contact or hazard samples into the initial camera with depth and occlusion checks.

open_risks.risk: Body Counterfactual items can still be solved from radius priors if controls are weak.
open_risks.mitigation: Enforce quotas for small_only flips, both_safe controls, neither_safe controls, large_shorter_same_bin controls, monotonicity rejection, and radius-only baseline reporting.

open_risks.risk: Concrete prompts can drift from executed rollouts if meter/body-width horizons are fixed at category level.
open_risks.mitigation: Render intended_distance_m and horizon_body_widths only from serialized per-case action_sequence, active radius, body_width_m, forward_step_size_m, and turn_step_deg.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk labels are invalid if support_loss or navmesh_support_violation fields are unavailable.
open_risks.mitigation: Emit insufficient_support only when one of those backend fields is present; otherwise use the three-way hazard variant and its own balance gate.

critique_items.issue: Concrete prompts omit approximate body-width horizon even though the goal requires body size plus direction angle and approximate meter/body-width horizon.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Append a phrase such as `约 {horizon_body_widths} 个车身宽度` to every model-facing template, computed per case.

critique_items.issue: metric_parameters contain fixed `horizon_m` and `horizon_body_widths` values while the spec allows multiple radii and action horizons.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Require per-case fields: `intended_distance_m = num_forward_steps * forward_step_size_m`, `body_width_m = 2 * active_radius_m`, and `horizon_body_widths = intended_distance_m / body_width_m`; render prompts only from these fields.

critique_items.issue: Action-Horizon metadata does not explicitly require forward-step count and total turn angle to be serialized and renderable for every item.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add generator-required fields `num_actions`, `num_forward_steps`, `total_turn_deg`, `action_sequence`, `intended_distance_m`, and `horizon_body_widths` for every Action-Horizon case.
